settings.credential: Found the handpan in 2019 · plays a C# Pygmy
settings.relation: The handpan came into my life in 2019 at a time in my life when I urgently needed to (re)find my creativity to realise that I hadn't been doing what I loved for too many years. The handpan literally changed my life, it gave me self-confidence, allowed me to escape, and above all to connect with myself and a creative part I didn't know I had.
settings.quote: Ayasa instruments are just DIVINE. Sounds like perfection, purity. I can feel that every single note is made with the higher intention it could be.
settings.relation_more:
Even though I don't make a living from handpans today and I don't want to, it allowed me to realise that I was not at the right place and I left everything I did. And today I'm so thankful for my wellbeing and mental health. I'd never want to go back.

Kim, please see Instagram
